# icon / config

The **icon** type's config capability: the `iconField` factory (core) and the
icon-picker renderer contributed to `config-v2.fields.renderer` (web).

The factory builds a config_v2 `FieldDef<SavedSymbolName | null>` carrying the
canonical `fields/` icon token (`@plugins/fields/plugins/icon/core`, id
`"icon"`). Its schema parses through `SavedSymbolNameSchema`, so a name the
installed sets cannot draw is never stored or read back. The default is `null`
(no icon chosen — the owner draws its own).
